name: Hydrogen compressors (diaphragm, ionic, reciprocating)
principle: Hydrogen is compressed with diaphragm compressors at lower flows and oil-free high-pressure piston compressors at higher flows. Burckhardt says its non-lubricated designs compress hydrogen up to 900 bar as a booster for trailer filling and refuelling stations. IEA rates hydrogen turbo compressors, which suit pipelines, at TRL 6.

process_steps.name: Suction from electrolyser, pipeline or trailer

source.note: Compressortech2, Burckhardt to develop hydrogen compressor systems, 28 October 2021
IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Hydrogen turbo compressors' 6 (2025)

limitations: Moving parts (diaphragms, valves) need maintenance; not quantified in the source
